title: Fan and AI game port takedowns (dataset)
description:
An open dataset of fan-made and AI-assisted ports of commercial video games (browser ports, PC ports, recompilations and decompilations) that were taken down after a copyright claim, with the rights holder, the dates, how long each port was online, and the evidence for every row. JSON and CSV.

It is the data behind the takedown tracker at portedgames.com/takedowns, part of PortedGames, a directory of fan and AI ports of classic games with each port's status checked daily. No game files are included or linked.
